request.question: Without citing any figure, in your own words: did 2193-Q4 revenue outpace 2193-Q3, or did it sag? One plain sentence, like 'Q4 sagged against Q3'.

reply: I compared revenue in 2193-Q4 with 2193-Q3, all genres. I'd rather not give a number I didn't look up. 2193-Q4's revenue was $112,511.47 lower than 2193-Q3's.
